label: your question
title: Request

router.description: Not a repair: rent, payments, deposit, utility bill, the lease or contract, moving in or out, parking, noise from neighbours, a dispute with a neighbour, rubbish or cleaning of shared areas, keys for a new flatmate.

neutral_message: I'll pass it to your property manager.
neutral_message_de: Ich gebe das an deine Hausverwaltung weiter.
extraction_hints: 'rent' / 'deposit' / 'utility bill' / 'payment' → mg_topic=rent; 'lease' / 'contract' / 'move out' / 'notice' / 'new flatmate' → mg_topic=contract; 'loud music' / 'noise' / 'party' / 'barking' → mg_topic=noise; 'my neighbour keeps' / 'argument with the neighbour' / 'their bikes in the hallway' → mg_topic=neighbour; anything else administrative → mg_topic=other. 'A problem with my neighbour' alone does not say what happened (noise, parking, a dispute): mg_topic is unknown until the tenant says what it is about.

questions.text: Is it about rent or payments, your contract, noise, or a neighbour?
questions.text_de: Geht es um Miete oder Zahlungen, deinen Vertrag, Lärm oder einen Nachbarn?

answers.contract: the lease or contract, moving in or out
answers.neighbour: a dispute or issue with a neighbour

questions.reask: And is it about rent, your contract, noise or a neighbour?
questions.reask_de: Und geht es um Miete, Vertrag, Lärm oder einen Nachbarn?

causes.label: Rent, deposit or payment question
causes.tenant_message: That's one for your property manager, Anna Becker. I've passed it on and she'll get back to you within two working days.
causes.tenant_message_de: Das klärt deine Hausverwalterin Anna Becker. Ich habe es weitergegeben, sie meldet sich innerhalb von zwei Werktagen.

causes.label: Lease or contract question (moving in or out, notice, flatmates)
causes.tenant_message: Contract questions go to your property manager, Anna Becker. I've passed it on and she'll get back to you within two working days.
causes.tenant_message_de: Vertragsfragen klärt deine Hausverwalterin Anna Becker. Ich habe es weitergegeben, sie meldet sich innerhalb von zwei Werktagen.

causes.label: Noise complaint
causes.tenant_message: I've passed this to your property manager, who will follow up with the neighbours. It helps to note dates and times; if it's very loud late at night, the police non-emergency line can help right away.
causes.tenant_message_de: Ich habe das an deine Hausverwaltung weitergegeben, sie spricht mit den Nachbarn. Notier dir am besten Datum und Uhrzeit; wenn es spät nachts sehr laut ist, hilft sofort auch die Polizei.

causes.label: Issue with a neighbour
causes.tenant_message: Thanks for telling me. I've passed it to your property manager, who will get in touch with you and, if needed, with the neighbour.
causes.tenant_message_de: Danke, dass du es mir sagst. Ich habe es an deine Hausverwaltung weitergegeben, sie meldet sich bei dir und bei Bedarf beim Nachbarn.

causes.label: Other administrative request
causes.tenant_message: I've passed it to your property manager, Anna Becker, and she'll get back to you within two working days.
causes.tenant_message_de: Ich habe es an deine Hausverwalterin Anna Becker weitergegeben, sie meldet sich innerhalb von zwei Werktagen.

strategy: Not a repair: no diagnosis questions beyond mg_topic (usually clear from the first message), hand it to property management.
Never promise an outcome (rent reduction, termination, a warning to the neighbour); the property manager decides.
At most 1 question. Never state a fact the tenant didn't give.
sources: reltix property management: what goes to the PM instead of a craftsman
